baseline_prompt_en: A cinematic photographic scene of European royal court life, set during a palace occasion. A woman of the court sits at an open harpsichord in a late-eighteenth-century royal music salon, interrupted between rehearsal and the arrival of her audience. Use the supplied reference photograph as face-and-hair appearance guidance for this woman: a softly rounded oval face, dark brown eyes, a small straight nose, softly full pink lips, and a dark chin-length bob with light separated fringe. Her pale blue silk court gown has a fitted square-neck bodice, gently structured sleeves and a wide skirt settling over the upholstered bench. She turns her face toward the open gilded doorway, her lips faintly parted with alert composure; the private concentration of practice is becoming a public performance. Her right forearm leads visibly from her sleeve to a relaxed right hand resting on the keyboard, one fingertip pressing a single ivory key. Her left forearm reaches easily to the open score on the music desk, her left fingertips holding its lower outer corner flat. The wrists and page contact remain visible together. Both feet are supported beneath her settled seated posture. Beyond the doorway, two distant courtiers in formal dress have paused facing the instrument, their waiting attention explaining her turn. The harpsichord keyboard occupies the lower foreground; its music desk and the woman form the central triangle, with the doorway deeper at frame right. Tall palace windows at frame left give her face soft afternoon light and a restrained warm sheen along the silk neckline; worn gilding, patterned parquet and a single crimson chair supply the royal setting. Photograph from a three-quarter position beside the keyboard at seated eye height, a medium-wide view that includes the hands, music desk and doorway, natural facial texture, delicate film grain and quiet color separation. The woman remains the clear visual center; the audience is smaller and readable within the room rather than dissolved into abstraction.
